mechanics.title: Item + Inventory System
mechanics.description: Pick up / drop a generic item in the world and store it in your inventory.

mechanics.title: BAG (Container Item)
mechanics.description: Special item you can drop/pick up which stores other items.

mechanics.title: Rope
mechanics.description: Can be extended to climb up.

mechanics.title: Piton
mechanics.description: Placed in a wall to hang on.

mechanics.title: Healing Item
mechanics.description: Basic consumable used to heal a debuff (injury, hunger).

mechanics.title: Crates / RNG Containers
mechanics.description: Crack them open to spawn random items.

mechanics.title: Veins (Jewel source)
mechanics.description: Mine them for Jewels — the shop purchase currency.

mechanics.title: Shop
mechanics.description: Spend Jewels on items and consumables; inventory unlocks as you complete missions.

mechanics.title: Shopkeeper
mechanics.description: You can steal from him — if you do, he chases you.

mechanics.title: SOS Beacon
mechanics.description: Signal other players you are stuck; they can take a mission to save you.

mechanics.title: Item Art
mechanics.description: Final visuals, animations, and balancing for all items.
